study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Phenotype of Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder Using Normative Models

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to predict brain volumes from age and sex.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Normative models were estimated using gaussian process regression, yielding coherent measures of predictive confidence in addition to point estimates.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) was used to estimate gray and white matter volumes. FreeSurfer was used to estimate cortical thickness and surface area.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Weestimated a normative brain aging model by using gaussian process regression to predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex using voxel-based morphometry-derived gray and white matter maps. To supplement this analysis... we also estimated normative models using Freesurfer-derived cortical thickness and pial area measures

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as predictors in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: predict regional gray and white matter volumes across the brain from age and sex
